content.title: How Does Hail Form? | Weather Science with David Payne
content.text: 🌩 How does hail form during a storm? Chief Meteorologist David Payne from News 9 breaks down the science of hail formation — explaining what causes hailstones to develop, how they grow inside thunderstorms, and why some hail is small while other storms produce damaging, giant hail. In this video, you’ll learn: ✅ The conditions inside a thunderstorm that create hail ✅ How updrafts and supercells influence hail size ✅ Why hail is more common in severe weather season ✅ The science behind hailstorms in Oklahoma and beyond ⚡ Whether you’re curious about weather science, studying meteorology, or just want to better understand severe storms, this clear explanation will help you see how hail forms step by step. 👉 Stay ahead of the forecast with Oklahoma’s Own News 9.
